records.question: What is the entitlement for casual leave in a calendar year for administrative staff?

citations.quoted_snippet: Casual leave admissible to an employee is eight days for a calendar year, subject to the condition that not more than five days’ casual leave may be allowed at a time.

records.answer: Administrative staff are entitled to eight days of casual leave per calendar year. This leave is subject to the condition that not more than five days of casual leave may be allowed at a time.

records.question: Can casual leave be accumulated or carried forward to the following calendar year?

citations.quoted_snippet: 5.1.7 Casual leave cannot be accumulated. Leave not availed in a particular calendar year will lapse at the end of that year.

records.answer: No, casual leave cannot be accumulated. Any leave not availed in a particular calendar year will lapse at the end of that year.

records.question: What is the maximum accumulation limit or ceiling on Earned Leave?

citations.document: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum
citations.section: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum > ### Section 3: Legal Hierarchy & Administrative Precedence
citations.quoted_snippet: Notwithstanding Section 5.2.2 of the Staff HR Policy Manual 2026 (which provides an institutional general ceiling of 300 days), the maximum permissible ceiling on the accumulation of Earned Leave for Executive Cadre Staff covered under this Memorandum shall be restricted to 180 days.

records.answer: The maximum accumulation limit on Earned Leave differs depending on the cadre. For Executive Cadre Staff covered by the Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum, the ceiling is 180 days. For all other staff, the Staff HR Policy Manual 2026 sets a general ceiling of 300 days.

records.question: How many days of Earned Leave are credited to an employee each year and on what dates?

citations.quoted_snippet: The administrative staff is entitled to 30 days of Earned Leave. Fifteen days will be credited to the employee’s account on 1st of January and 15 days on 1st of July.

records.answer: An employee receives a total of 30 days of Earned Leave each year, credited in two equal installments of 15 days each – the first 15 days on 1 January and the second 15 days on 1 July.

records.question: What is the maximum number of Earned Leave days that can be availed at a single time?

records.answer: An employee may avail up to 180 days of Earned Leave at a single time.

records.question: What is the maximum Earned Leave accumulation ceiling: 300 days or 180 days?

citations.document: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum
citations.section: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum > ### Section 3: Legal Hierarchy & Administrative Precedence
citations.quoted_snippet: Notwithstanding Section 5.2.2 of the Staff HR Policy Manual 2026 (which provides an institutional general ceiling of 300 days), the maximum permissible ceiling on the accumulation of Earned Leave for Executive Cadre Staff covered under this Memorandum shall be restricted to 180 days.

citations.document: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum
citations.section: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum > ### Section 3: Legal Hierarchy & Administrative Precedence
citations.quoted_snippet: For matters concerning general non-executive staff, the Master Staff HR Policy Manual 2026 remains the sole authoritative baseline.

records.answer: The maximum Earned Leave accumulation ceiling depends on the employee's cadre. For general staff, the ceiling is 300 days as per the IIMA HR Policy Manual (Staff) 2026. However, for Executive Cadre Staff (Senior Administrative Officers Level 11 and above), the ceiling is restricted to 180 days as per the Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum. The Addendum explicitly states that its 180-day limit applies 'Notwithstanding' the general 300-day ceiling in the Staff HR Policy Manual for the specific executive cadres it covers.

records.question: Are executive staff subject to a different Earned Leave accumulation limit than general staff?

citations.document: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum
citations.section: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum > ### Section 3: Legal Hierarchy & Administrative Precedence
citations.quoted_snippet: Notwithstanding Section 5.2.2 of the Staff HR Policy Manual 2026 (which provides an institutional general ceiling of 300 days), the maximum permissible ceiling on the accumulation of Earned Leave for Executive Cadre Staff ... shall be restricted to 180 days.
The existing ceiling on the accumulation of EL is 300 days.

records.answer: Yes. For executive cadre staff the Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum sets a lower Earned Leave accumulation ceiling of 180 days, whereas the general staff ceiling in the IIMA HR Policy Manual 2026 is 300 days.

records.question: How are excess leave days treated at year-end for executive cadre employees under the 2026 memorandum?

citations.document: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum
citations.section: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum > ### Section 3: Legal Hierarchy & Administrative Precedence
citations.quoted_snippet: Any Earned Leave standing to the credit of an Executive Cadre employee in excess of 180 days at the close of the calendar year (31st December) shall be automatically converted to cash encashment up to a maximum of 15 days, with the remainder lapsing immediately.

records.answer: For executive cadre staff, any Earned Leave balance that exceeds 180 days on 31 December is handled as follows: the excess is automatically converted into cash encashment, but only up to a maximum of 15 days. Any remaining days beyond that 15‑day encashment limit lapse and are forfeited.
